identity.name: load_bylaw_map_areas
identity.description: Loads the pinned 600.60 Sixplex Overlay map seed (by-law 654-2025 Diagrams 1/2: the City GIS layer-80 areas with their holes, plus the CKAN TEY wards and ward 23) from scripts/seeds/bylaw/maps/600_60.geojson into bylaw_map_areas: guarded upsert on area_key plus a scoped departure delete, in one transaction. The seed is never fetched live; its md5/sha256 are pinned in the seed manifest.

why_lock.text: Mutual exclusion with every other writer of bylaw_map_areas (Spec 47 §A.5 next-free id 127; 58 is load_zoning). The shell keeps `const ADVISORY_LOCK_ID = 127;` as a §5.4 source-text constant, asserted equal by the pipeline advisory-lock suite.

why.text: The upsert and the scoped departure DELETE commit together: a committed upsert with a rolled-back delete would leave a map area the adopted seed no longer carries, and enrich_parcels decides 600.60 membership from every row of this table. A new seed rewrites every row once (seed_sha256 changes), so the change ratio is unbounded on that run and zero on a re-run.
Exactly two write statements reach bylaw_map_areas: the guarded upsert and the scoped departure DELETE. The geometry validation is a read-only PostGIS SELECT.

on_prior_run_error_why.text: The prior completed run's content hash is the only gate this step has (a filesystem external has no HEAD validators). A failed read must not degrade to first-run and rewrite the table silently; refusing is the visible posture.

why.text: Migration 254 enables RLS on bylaw_map_areas with ZERO policies (Spec 114 Class B). Under a non-bypass role the load writes 0 rows with NO error and the verdict reads PASS. The bypass is the precondition, checked before the first read (load_coa_notices precedent).
geom is GEOMETRY(MultiPolygon,4326) and the write validates it with ST_MakeValid; without PostGIS the step cannot store a map area at all.
The GiST index the enrich_parcels sixplex pass filters candidate areas through; without it the consumer degrades to a sequential scan per parcel.

on_row_error_why.text: A seed feature that fails shapeRecord (key/source mismatch, an area type or map code the manifest does not carry) is counted by reason and skipped, and the pre_write FAIL check source_counts_match_manifest then refuses the whole write: no map area is ever silently missing.

on_check_error_why.text: Every check reads a value the library already measured or the pinned manifest, so a check that throws is a defect, not an upstream condition: it must redden the run.

why.text: Operator ruling 2026-10-08 (Q-A1): the City GIS layer states no licence; it is used LOCALLY and recorded as 'not stated — City of Toronto GIS, unverified', and a cloud/prod publish waits until it is confirmed. This row carries the recorded ruling on every run so the provenance is read from the audit table, never assumed.

The seed is pinned (Spec 68 §9 G-PROV): the bytes the library hashed while copying the file must be the bytes map-seed.mjs --adopt recorded. A hand-edited or half-adopted seed (crash between the two renames) is refused before any write. The library's content hash is md5, so the manifest records seed_md5 beside seed_sha256. The manifest itself is committed data required at load: a missing manifest, or one whose seed_sha256 / seed_md5 / map_code / sources / area_types is malformed, fails the step at load (BMA_E_MANIFEST), so no run is ever scored against an unpinned seed.

order_guarantee.guarantee: The acquired content hash is compared with the manifest seed_md5 before the write is prepared, so a seed whose bytes differ from the pin is refused before any write — no transaction is opened and bylaw_map_areas is untouched.
order_guarantee.anchor: the map is refused before any write

why.text: Measured 2026-10-08: layer 80 holds 18 features (returnCountOnly) and the ward union is the 8 TEY wards + ward 23; both pins are the manifest's. A shaped count per source that differs from the manifest means a feature was skipped by shapeRecord or the seed is wrong; either way 600.60 membership would be computed against a partial map, so the write is refused.

order_guarantee.guarantee: Each source's shaped feature count is scored against the manifest (18 GIS, 9 wards) before the write is prepared, so a source with a wrong count is refused before any write — no transaction is opened and bylaw_map_areas is untouched.
order_guarantee.anchor: the map is refused before any write

expect.reports: seed features whose area_key is not <source>:<positive integer>

why.text: A feature with a malformed area_key is dropped by the parse; a dropped map area is land whose 600.60 status silently changes, so any bad key refuses the write.

order_guarantee.guarantee: The count of seed features whose area_key is not <source>:<positive integer> is scored before the write is prepared, so any malformed key is refused before any write — no transaction is opened and bylaw_map_areas is untouched.
order_guarantee.anchor: the map is refused before any write

why.text: ON CONFLICT cannot affect a row twice; dedupeBySourceId keeps the first and this count is the only evidence two different polygons shared a key. map-seed.mjs checkSeed already refuses duplicates, so a non-zero here is a seed that bypassed the adopt door.

order_guarantee.guarantee: The count of seed features sharing an area_key is scored before the write is prepared, so any duplicate key is refused before any write — no transaction is opened and bylaw_map_areas is untouched.
order_guarantee.anchor: the map is refused before any write

why.text: A null geometry is dropped at parse, before validation; for a 27-feature legal map that is a missing area, so it refuses the write.

order_guarantee.guarantee: The count of seed features carrying no geometry is scored before the write is prepared, so any null geometry is refused before any write — no transaction is opened and bylaw_map_areas is untouched.
order_guarantee.anchor: the map is refused before any write

expect.reports: features the geometry validation could not make valid

why.text: Unlike a 854-polygon ravine layer there is no tolerable loss rate for a by-law map: one unrepairable area changes the overlay. Zero, scored before the write.

order_guarantee.guarantee: The count of features the geometry validation could not make valid is scored before the write is prepared, so any unrepairable geometry is refused before any write — no transaction is opened and bylaw_map_areas is untouched.
order_guarantee.anchor: the map is refused before any write

why.text: F-C1: `key <> ALL('{}')` is true for every row, so an empty parse would retract the whole table; the library suppresses that DELETE and this row makes the suppression visible.

A kind:"filesystem" external that resolves to no file is the library's declared tier-1 skip no_source_file (acquire.js 0fs), landing a COMPLETED skipped_no_source_file row, not a failure. The seed is committed in the repository, so a missing file is a repo defect caught first by src/tests/steps/load_bylaw_map_areas/bylaw-maps.infra.test.ts; the step does not add a second, bespoke posture.

deviations.adjudicated_by: Spec 124 Rule 1 (one home: the library's filesystem posture); WF1 phase2-inputs A3

deviations.from: the plan's two seed files and composite key (source, source_feature_id)

why.text: ONE seed file carries both sources (one pin, one staleness stamp) and the INGESTOR key is the text area_key = source:source_feature_id, which the migration's CHECK ties to the pair it replaces (UNIQUE (source, source_feature_id) is kept). Accepted by the operator 2026-10-08.

limitations.what: Geometry is validated for type and validity and the seed is checked against a Toronto lon/lat box at adopt time, but nothing here compares the City GIS layer with the by-law's Diagram 1 image: the 881 holes (R-10b) are loaded as published and their meaning is ruled downstream (Q-A2).
limitations.measured: research note phase2-inputs-research.md (A): 937 residential lots in 881 holes; 245 edge lots

limitations.what: The licence of the City GIS layer is not stated; the step runs locally only, in its own operator-triggered chain (bylaw_maps, the coa_notices posture), never in a scheduled chain. Nothing in the step itself blocks a cloud run — the publish hold is an operator rule recorded by dataset_source_license and the manifest publish_scope.

The content-hash gate compares the seed bytes only: a change to this step's compute or migration with an unchanged seed lands skipped_content_hash and does not reload (no code_version trigger — the INGESTOR fleet posture; only load_coa_notices, whose parser output is versioned, carries one). A deliberate reload after such a change is BYLAW_MAP_FORCE_RELOAD=1 (recovery.force).
limitations.measured: declared: staleness.trigger = content_hash only; 27 rows, the seed changes about yearly

recovery.reset: TRUNCATE is never correct here: re-adopt the seed (map-seed.mjs --refresh then --adopt) and re-run; the guarded upsert plus departure delete converges the table. BYLAW_MAP_FORCE_RELOAD=1 bypasses the content-hash gate for a deliberate reload.

interrupted_why.text: The only write target declares retract "departed" (a scoped departure DELETE keyed by this run's own keys, inside the step transaction), not a mode-gated full retraction, so a kill leaves either nothing or the committed load.

before_image_why.text: The generic before-image mirrors a retraction scope predicate; this target's departure DELETE is keyed by an id array with write_discipline.scope none, so there is nothing to mirror (the load_ravines R-M / LG-17 posture).

why.text: The seed file is absent (library tier-1 skip no_source_file). Completed, so the consumer's completed-row read keeps the prior block; the repo-level infra test is what reddens a missing committed seed.
The seed bytes are identical to the prior completed run's: the normal outcome between adoptions. The prior block is re-emitted so enrich_parcels' pin still reads a completed row.
The seed bytes do not match the manifest pin: refused before any write.
A source's shaped feature count differs from the manifest: refused before any write.
A seed feature carried a malformed area_key: refused before any write.
Two seed features shared an area_key: refused before any write.
A seed feature carried no geometry: refused before any write.
A map area could not be made valid: refused before any write.
guards.empty_source: the acquired seed has 0 rows to write; the write is refused and bylaw_map_areas is untouched.
The local copy or the GeoJSON parse threw; nothing was written.
Advisory lock 127 is held by another process; the library emits a row-derived SKIP summary.
